name: Introduction to Machine Learning
description: Introduction to machine learning. Unsupervised learning: K-means, Gaussian mixture models, EM. Unsupervised learning: eigen-analysis: PCA, LDA and subspaces. Linear models for regression and classification. SVMs and kernels. Introduction to neural networks: the perceptron, the XOR problem. Backpropagation. Convolutional neural networks. Neural network architectures: characteristics, LeNet-5, AlexNet, VGG, ResNet, inception, U-net, EfficientNet. Recurrent neural networks. Generative AI: generative adversarial networks. Generative AI: diffusion models. XAI: explainable AI: the math, architectures, Bayesian neural networks. Basics of transformers. Foundational models, transformer implementation details. Multi-head attention, encoder, decoder architectures. Prompting, PEFT, LoRA.
